title: RawItem
description: What every adapter emits: 'someone said something, somewhere, that may describe an event'. One JSON object per line in inbox/<run>/<source>.jsonl.

id.description: Stable id: <source_type>:<source_name>:<native id or hash of url+text>

source_name.description: Site name, IG handle, group name, or scout model name

source_url.description: Permalink to the post/page when one exists

posted_at.description: When the source published it, if known

text.description: Caption, page text, message body. Verbatim, trimmed.

media.description: Image/video URLs (flyers). Not stored, only referenced.

ocr_text.description: Text read off a flyer image, when the caption is thin

meta.description: Adapter-specific extras: likes, comments, hashtags, page title
